title: jwt.created
description: Published by auth-service (RabbitMQ auth.exchange, routing key jwt.created) on every login. Consumed by products-service (caches when role=SELLER), orders-service, billing-service, and notification-service (all cache unconditionally). userId is an integer here -- a real drift found and fixed (see ADR-0002's Update): JwtCreatedEvent.userId used to be a String (the JWT subject claim, unconverted), while every consumer already treated it as numeric and only worked by Jackson/Python's implicit string-to-number coercion.
